# BrokerLifecycleManager Analysis

## (1) Initial BrokerState

- **Field**: `state` (line 121)
- **Initial Value**: `BrokerState.NOT_RUNNING`
- **Code**: `private volatile BrokerState state = BrokerState.NOT_RUNNING;`

---

## (2) All EventQueue.Event Inner Classes

### 1. **BeginControlledShutdownEvent** (lines 314–332)
- **BrokerState set**: `BrokerState.PENDING_CONTROLLED_SHUTDOWN` (line 321)
  - `state = BrokerState.PENDING_CONTROLLED_SHUTDOWN;`
- **Enqueued by**: Public method `beginControlledShutdown()` (line 340)
  - `eventQueue.append(new BeginControlledShutdownEvent());`
- **Triggered**: Called by external code (KafkaServer) to initiate controlled shutdown
- **Quote**: `case RUNNING -> { logger.info("Beginning controlled shutdown."); state = BrokerState.PENDING_CONTROLLED_SHUTDOWN;` (lines 320–321)

### 2. **ResendBrokerRegistrationEvent** (lines 283–290)
- **BrokerState set**: None (clears `registered = false`)
- **Enqueued by**: Public method `resendBrokerRegistration()` (line 278)
  - `eventQueue.append(new ResendBrokerRegistrationEvent());`
- **Triggered**: External call to force re-registration
- **Quote**: `registered = false; scheduleNextCommunicationImmediately();` (lines 285–286)

### 3. **SetReadyToUnfenceEvent** (lines 350–357)
- **BrokerState set**: None (sets internal flag `readyToUnfence = true`)
- **Enqueued by**: Public method `setReadyToUnfence()` (line 213)
  - `eventQueue.append(new SetReadyToUnfenceEvent());`
- **Triggered**: External call when broker recovery work is complete
- **Quote**: `readyToUnfence = true; scheduleNextCommunicationImmediately();` (lines 352–353)

### 4. **OfflineDirEvent** (lines 359–372)
- **BrokerState set**: None (updates internal map `offlineDirs`)
- **Enqueued by**: Public method `propagateDirectoryFailure()` (line 224)
  - `eventQueue.append(new OfflineDirEvent(directory));`
- **Triggered**: Directory I/O failure detection in broker
- **Quote**: `offlineDirs.put(dir, false); if (registered) { scheduleNextCommunicationImmediately(); }` (lines 366–368)

### 5. **OfflineDirBrokerFailureEvent** (lines 374–387)
- **BrokerState set**: None (triggers shutdown hook)
- **Enqueued by**: Public method `propagateDirectoryFailure()` (line 224)
  - `eventQueue.scheduleDeferred("offlineDirFailure", new EventQueue.DeadlineFunction(...), new OfflineDirBrokerFailureEvent(directory));`
- **Triggered**: Deferred timeout (configured duration after `propagateDirectoryFailure()` call) if offline directory not communicated to controller
- **Quote**: `if (!offlineDirs.getOrDefault(offlineDir, false)) { logger.error("Shutting down because couldn't communicate offline log dir..."); shutdownHook.run(); }` (lines 382–384)

### 6. **CordonedDirEvent** (lines 389–400)
- **BrokerState set**: None (updates internal set `cordonedLogDirs`)
- **Enqueued by**: Public method `propagateDirectoryCordoned()` (line 232)
  - `eventQueue.append(new CordonedDirEvent(directories));`
- **Triggered**: External call when log directories are cordoned
- **Quote**: `cordonedLogDirs = dirs; if (registered) { scheduleNextCommunicationImmediately(); }` (lines 394–396)

### 7. **StartupEvent** (lines 399–427)
- **BrokerState set**: `BrokerState.STARTING` (line 417)
  - `state = BrokerState.STARTING;`
- **Enqueued by**: Public method `start()` (line 196)
  - `eventQueue.append(new StartupEvent(...));`
- **Triggered**: Broker startup (called by KafkaServer)
- **Quote**: `state = BrokerState.STARTING; ... sendBrokerRegistration(); logger.info("Incarnation {} of broker {} in cluster {} is now STARTING.", incarnationId, nodeId, clusterId);` (lines 417–425)

### 8. **BrokerRegistrationResponseEvent** (lines 761–823)
- **BrokerState set**: None (does not set state; transitions handled in heartbeat response)
  - On success: sets `brokerEpoch`, `registered = true`, `initialRegistrationSucceeded = true`
- **Enqueued by**: Response handlers `BrokerRegistrationResponseHandler.onComplete()` (line 795) and `onTimeout()` (line 798)
  - `eventQueue.prepend(new BrokerRegistrationResponseEvent(response, false));` or `(null, true)`
- **Triggered**: Controller response to registration request or registration RPC timeout
- **Quote**: `if (errorCode == Errors.NONE) { brokerEpoch = message.data().brokerEpoch(); registered = true; ... logger.info("Successfully registered broker {} with broker epoch {}", nodeId, brokerEpoch);` (lines 805–809)

### 9. **BrokerHeartbeatResponseEvent** (lines 806–880)
- **BrokerState set**: 
  - `BrokerState.RECOVERY` (line 830) when transitioning from STARTING and `isCaughtUp()`
    - `state = BrokerState.RECOVERY;`
  - `BrokerState.RUNNING` (line 840) when in RECOVERY and `!isFenced()`
    - `state = BrokerState.RUNNING;`
- **Enqueued by**: Response handlers `BrokerHeartbeatResponseHandler.onComplete()` (line 795) and `onTimeout()` (line 798)
  - `eventQueue.prepend(new BrokerHeartbeatResponseEvent(response, false, currentOfflineDirs));` or `(null, true, ...)`
- **Triggered**: Controller response to heartbeat request or heartbeat RPC timeout; scheduled periodically via `CommunicationEvent`
- **Quote**: 
  - STARTING→RECOVERY: `if (responseData.isCaughtUp()) { logger.info("The broker has caught up. Transitioning from STARTING to RECOVERY."); state = BrokerState.RECOVERY; initialCatchUpFuture.complete(null);` (lines 829–832)
  - RECOVERY→RUNNING: `if (!responseData.isFenced()) { logger.info("The broker has been unfenced. Transitioning from RECOVERY to RUNNING."); initialUnfenceFuture.complete(null); state = BrokerState.RUNNING;` (lines 838–841)

### 10. **RegistrationTimeoutEvent** (lines 844–852)
- **BrokerState set**: None (triggers shutdown)
- **Enqueued by**: Deferred by `StartupEvent.run()` (line 420)
  - `eventQueue.scheduleDeferred("initialRegistrationTimeout", new EventQueue.DeadlineFunction(time.nanoseconds() + initialTimeoutNs), new RegistrationTimeoutEvent());`
- **Triggered**: Timer fires after `config.initialRegistrationTimeoutMs()` if registration not completed
- **Quote**: `if (!initialRegistrationSucceeded) { logger.error("Shutting down because we were unable to register with the controller quorum."); eventQueue.beginShutdown("registrationTimeout"); }` (lines 846–849)

### 11. **CommunicationEvent** (lines 854–865)
- **BrokerState set**: None (delegates to registration or heartbeat sending)
- **Enqueued by**: Deferred by `scheduleNextCommunication()` (line 824)
  - `eventQueue.scheduleDeferred("communication", new EventQueue.DeadlineFunction(deadlineNs), new CommunicationEvent());`
- **Triggered**: Timer fires to send next registration or heartbeat; re-enqueued by registration/heartbeat response handlers
- **Quote**: `if (communicationInFlight) { logger.trace("Delaying communication..."); nextSchedulingShouldBeImmediate = true; } else if (registered) { sendBrokerHeartbeat(); } else { sendBrokerRegistration(); }` (lines 857–862)

### 12. **ShutdownEvent** (lines 870–881)
- **BrokerState set**: `BrokerState.SHUTTING_DOWN` (line 873)
  - `state = BrokerState.SHUTTING_DOWN;`
- **Enqueued by**: Registered during `KafkaEventQueue` construction (line 181)
  - `new KafkaEventQueue(time, logContext, threadNamePrefix + "lifecycle-manager-", new ShutdownEvent());`
- **Triggered**: EventQueue shutdown mechanism (called when `eventQueue.close()` or `beginShutdown()` invoked)
- **Quote**: `logger.info("Transitioning from {} to {}.", state, BrokerState.SHUTTING_DOWN); state = BrokerState.SHUTTING_DOWN; controlledShutdownFuture.complete(null);` (lines 871–873)

---

## State Machine Flow (Order of Transitions)

```
NOT_RUNNING (initial, line 121)
    ↓ [start() → StartupEvent]
STARTING (line 417)
    ↓ [BrokerHeartbeatResponseEvent: isCaughtUp() → true, line 830]
RECOVERY (line 830)
    ↓ [BrokerHeartbeatResponseEvent: !isFenced() → true, line 840]
RUNNING (line 840)
    ↓ [beginControlledShutdown() → BeginControlledShutdownEvent, line 321]
PENDING_CONTROLLED_SHUTDOWN (line 321)
    ↓ [BrokerHeartbeatResponseEvent: shouldShutDown() → true, line 863 → beginShutdown()]
SHUTTING_DOWN (line 873)
```
